name: eevee-material-stencil-aov-clear
purpose: Verify that stencil-enabled deferred materials in a secondary EEVEE layer still clear stale AOV data under their covered pixels.
passCriteria: A back plane writes a red color AOV, a front raytrace-transmission DITHERED plane covers the center and uses read-only material stencil. The Filter Graph displays the AOV: corner pixels remain red from the back plane, while center pixels covered by both the plain and stencil front planes are black.
